transform.rootConvention: world root unchanged; transform entire visual local rig about same fixed root; logic collision center/radius unchanged
transform.camera: same approved three-quarter camera; neither mirrored rig nor UP requires camera swap
transform.countInvariant: 原body拓扑与器官数量不变；脸部锚随rig变换而非复制，炮组始终刚性
transform.physics: art local transform only; projectile logical origin remains owner.x/y; actual shot count/angle/lifecycle unchanged
transform.limits: diagram coordinates/angle labels are proposed, not measured anchors, solved 3D projection or verified production rotation limits

baseTransform.formula: x' = 2*root.x - x; y' = y; root' = root
baseTransform.anchorRule: P和所有M随所属rig同时镜像；M出口中心由组合变换得到，禁止只换枪口角而保留右侧P
baseTransform.externalUI: 等级点徽/文字/HUD保持独立可读，不随body镜像

residualAim.operation: after whole-rig mirror, rotate rigid launcher group at mirrored P toward actual target only as construction permits
residualAim.order: whole rig mirror -> mirrored P/M -> residual local aiming -> explicit projection/occlusion if needed
residualAim.avoid: 不在未镜像的右侧P直接转180；不穿体、不使炮架漂浮
